shared_elements: round/pointed-topped stela field with framing border
human figures in profile with frontal shoulders
offering table or stand with offerings before a seated figure
standing or seated figure with arm extended in offering/adoration gesture
columns of pictographic script signs filling the field
figures facing inward toward the scene's centre
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: a profile seated figure on a chair with an offering stand set before it, approached by another figure with arm extended, all combined with columns of small pictographic signs inside a bordered, round-topped panel, rendered in the same shallow-relief profile convention (frontal shoulders, profile head and legs). The main difference in content is scale and organisation: A devotes nearly the whole field to a single large seated deity-like figure with elaborate crown, staff and skirt confronted by one worshipper, while B subdivides the field into registers of many small subsidiary figures around a dominant mass of text.
